title: Height and Setback Requirements — R6 Through R12 Districts (Quality Housing) + Sky Exposure Plane
description: Minimum base height, maximum base height, and maximum building height table for all R6-R12 Quality Housing districts. Sky exposure plane rules for height factor alternative.

quality_housing_key_rules: Per §23-432 table: minimum base height, maximum base height, maximum building height by district
Setback required at height between minimum and maximum base height — per §23-433
Quality Housing street wall location: no closer to street than buildings within 150 ft on same block, up to 15 ft depth
R6B, R7B, R8B are excluded from certain §23-44 alternative location allowances
Tower regulations §23-435 apply in non-contextual R6-R9 districts
Mandatory in R6A, R6B, R6D, R7A, R7B, R7D, R7X, R8A, R8B, R8X, R9A, R9D, R9X, R10A, R10X
sky_exposure_plane_rules: Applies to Height Factor buildings in R6-R9 non-contextual districts
Per §23-633: sky exposure plane slope determined by district — building mass cannot penetrate
In R6-R7 districts: sky exposure plane starts at ~60 ft above street line
In R8-R10 districts: sky exposure plane starts at ~85 ft above street line
Slope: 2.5 to 1 (rise to run) in medium density (R6-R7); steeper slope in high density (R8-R10)
Per §23-736: tower may penetrate sky exposure plane in R9-R10 per §23-737
Sky exposure plane calculated from street line; different base planes for different building portions

dob_filing_notes: Verify district type: Quality Housing mandatory vs. Height Factor optional — different envelope calculations
Sky exposure plane calculated from base plane per §23-631; multiple base planes possible on sloped sites
Setback depth: 10 ft on wide streets, 15 ft on narrow streets above max base height
BSA special permit needed for height modifications beyond §23-432 table
